def recursive_solve(val, level):
    quotient = val // base_powers[level]
    if val % base_powers[level] == 0:
        return level * quotient
    optionA = level * quotient + recursive_solve(val % base_powers[level], level - 1)
    optionB = level * (quotient + 1) + recursive_solve(base_powers[level] - (val % base_powers[level]), level - 1)
    return min(optionA, optionB)

base_powers = [0] * 18
base_powers[1] = 1
for i in range(2, 18):
    base_powers[i] = base_powers[i - 1] * 10 + 1

input_number = int(input())
print(recursive_solve(input_number, 17))
